_comment: Copy this file to channels.json and fill in your teams. channels.json is gitignored because webhook URLs are secrets. Each team gets alerts only for the apps it matches; the env-configured SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL / email channel always receives the full report. An app matches a team if its client ID is listed in app_ids OR its display name contains any app_name_patterns entry (case-insensitive). slack_channel_id is optional and only needed for Excel report uploads (requires SLACK_BOT_TOKEN in .env).

teams.name: Example Team
teams.action_hint: Optional free-text instructions appended to this team's alerts, e.g. where to rotate the secret and what to update afterwards.
